trait.description: Does not retreat upon receiving lethal damage, instead swaps to a <Substitute> (Substitute has 0 Block). Swaps back to the original after 20 seconds

modules.name: New Friends
missions: During battle, have your own Mutsumi Wakaba use Destruction and Renewal a total of 6 times
Clear Main Theme 13-16 with a 3-star rating under Standard Environment; You must deploy your own Mutsumi Wakaba, and cannot include any other Specialist Operators as members

talents.name: Another 'Her'
